cases.name: Tracy Ellen Wold Julian
cases.about: He robituary said, "Tracy attended Proctor High School 1977. She married Randy C. Jorgensen, 1975, divorced, married Michael O’Hehir, 1982 (deceased 1991), married Raymond Julian, 1996. Tracy was a member of the Duluth Woman’s Bowling Association 1984-1991, Member of The 242 Yacht Club Duluth, 1984-1991, she had a love for weaving, boating and the Lake Superior waterfront."
